reason: The cited evidence does not directly support the key premises. E1 discusses thermal stability of nanocrystalline HEA films, not mechanical or thermal expansion effects of grain boundaries. E2 examines phase transformation kinetics in a different HEA (Al0.5CoCrFeNi) using thermal expansion, not grain boundary effects on elastic/thermal properties. E3 studies dynamic recrystallization in a TRIP-HEA, not HfNbTaTiZr, and does not address elastic modulus or thermal expansion. None of the cited passages provide evidence that grain boundaries modify elastic modulus or thermal expansion in the target
